tells.1: Stock filler ('certainly kept us on our toes', 'catch your breath') and an em-dash tacked onto the closing line make it feel padded and formulaic.
tells.2: The 'Welcome to this month's Hive Report' greeting comes at the end, after the content it should introduce.
tells.3: The standalone 'We're glad to have you along' feels stiff, and 'Wherever you are with your winter preparations' doesn't connect to 'how your season went'.
tells.5: 'You're not alone. Most of us are in the same boat' says the same thing twice, and the welcome still comes at the end.

reason: Version 4 puts the welcome where it belongs, stays warm without padding, and turns the workshop details into a natural invitation. Its short closing line reads like a real club secretary signing off.
